captions.instagram:
Floating walnut desk, wall to wall, in Highbury.

No legs. The desk is carried by the walls and a batten fixed to a level line, with four walnut drawers built in under the top. They pull out from underneath, so there are no handles on show.

Drawer boxes first, then the level line, then the top, then the drawers.

Fitted furniture in London: rafcarpentry.com
